scientific_integrity: The passive saddle equation is previously published; the new contribution is a singular high-reset active correction, its orientation threshold and globally quantified crossover. Analytical same-model assessment, not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Positive thermal diffusion and finite fixed propulsion
Complete Poisson reset of position and velocity plus orientation
Pointwise z>0 singular high-rate limit; no finite-rate prefactors or partial reset theorem
Passive saddle implicit equation is prior work; originality priority remains qualified
The subleading isotropic formula requires strictly positive rotational Brownian diffusivity fixed before the reset-rate limit; the zero-diffusivity case is discontinuous.
title: A singular orientation threshold in high-reset inertial active-particle tails
